title: RCMP watchdog probes Alberta in-custody death
article: The RCMP watchdog is investigating the force's actions regarding the in-custody death of a woman in northern Alberta.

Charlene Danais, 28, was found unconscious and not breathing Sunday in an RCMP detention cell in Assumption, about 900 kilometres northwest of Edmonton. She had been arrested on mischief charges at 5 p.m. MT the day prior.
An autopsy could not determine how she died, and toxicology tests are pending.
The Commission for Public Complaints Against the RCMP said Thursday it is looking into "the adequacy of the actions" of RCMP officers during Danais's arrest and subsequent death.

"We simply want to have a full account for what happened to identify ultimately to the public how the case was handled, if there are any concerns related to the RCMP's response," commission spokesperson Jamie Robertson said.
The commission hopes to wrap up its investigation in about a year.

The RCMP's major crimes unit is also examining the case. The Alberta Serious Incident Response Team, which probes police incidents that lead to serious injury or death, was contacted but is no longer involved.
